gnosh mcp

  Add, list, show and remove MCP servers. They are kept in gnosh's own
  mcp.json (local and user servers) and in a project's .mcp.json (project
  servers), in Claude Code's shape. A local server is a project's and yours
  alone; a server in .mcp.json goes with the project, and is used once its
  folder is trusted.

  None of these commands is built yet in this build of gnosh: typing one stops
  with a message that says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp <command> [flags] [arguments]

Commands
  add <name> <command-or-url> [args...]
                          Add a server. (Not built yet.)
  add-json <name> <json>  Add a server from its entry, as JSON. (Not built
                          yet.)
  get <name>              Show one server, and whether it connects. (Not built
                          yet.)
  list                    List the servers this folder uses, and whether each
                          connects. (Not built yet.)
  remove <name>           Remove a server. (Not built yet.)
  login <name>            Sign in to a server at a URL that wants it. (Not
                          built yet.)
  logout <name>           Forget the sign-in to a server at a URL. (Not built
                          yet.)

Flags
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
